sources.title: Bureau of Administrative Adjudication - Hearing Information
sources.publisher: City of Buffalo Bureau of Administrative Adjudication
sources.purpose: City hearing, default, payment, and appeal information for administrative-adjudication matters.
useFor: identifying the City's hearing route
checking what the agency says about a missed hearing or appeal
finding the current office phone
limits: The page is general information. The specific notice controls the case and may contain different dates or instructions.

sources.title: Administrative Appeal Form
sources.publisher: City of Buffalo Zoning Board of Appeals / Office of Strategic Planning
sources.purpose: Current City form and process notes for an administrative zoning appeal.
useFor: checking the City's stated filing materials and routing
capturing the hearing and notice sequence
building a submission checklist
capture: appeal basis as stated on the form
limits: The form's steps and fees can change. It does not determine whether a particular appeal is timely or meritorious.

sources.title: Permits & Inspections Data Resources
sources.publisher: City of Buffalo Department of Permit and Inspection Services
sources.purpose: Official index of City permit, inspection, violation, summons, and zoning data resources.
useFor: finding the right public dataset for a notice
checking case or permit identifiers
routing questions to Permit and Inspection Services
limits: Dataset records can be incomplete or delayed. Use the notice and agency case file for the controlling facts.

sources.title: FOIL Requests
sources.purpose: City public-record request route when a case record or supporting document is not posted.
useFor: requesting a copy of a record
logging the request and response
finding any posted release
limits: FOIL requests can take time and can be denied or redacted. A request does not pause a notice deadline unless the agency says so.

sources.title: Freedom of Information Law Request Form
sources.purpose: County department FOIL request form and routing notes.
useFor: requesting a county record
recording department selection and request wording
checking the county's acknowledgment process
limits: Independent county offices use separate processes. A FOIL request does not automatically extend another case deadline.

sources.title: How to Appeal a FOIL Decision
sources.purpose: County Clerk-specific FOIL denial appeal instructions and form link.
useFor: checking the appeal recipient and stated timing
building an appeal packet with the original request and denial
logging the appeal
limits: This page covers the County Clerk's office, not every Erie County department. Verify the controlling notice and current page.

sources.title: Fair Hearings
sources.publisher: Erie County Department of Social Services and New York State Office of Temporary and Disability Assistance
sources.purpose: Fair-hearing information for a County Social Services decision and the notice's aid-continuing instructions.
useFor: identifying the hearing channel named by a benefits notice
recording the request method and postmark or fax proof
checking the agency contact
limits: The notice controls the case. The page warns that preserving aid-continuing rights depends on the instructions and timing described in the Notice of Intent.

sources.title: Make a FOIL Request
sources.publisher: New York State Committee on Open Government
sources.purpose: State FOIL process, request specificity, response, and appeal guidance.
useFor: checking the general State FOIL sequence
drafting a specific records description
finding the stated appeal window
limits: This is general guidance, not case-specific legal advice. Agency procedures and exemptions still apply.

sources.title: Challenge Your Assessment
sources.publisher: New York State Department of Taxation and Finance
sources.purpose: State-level explanation and routing for challenging a local property assessment.
useFor: identifying the local assessor or grievance route named by the State
building a question list from an assessment notice
capturing the applicable local filing instructions
limits: Assessment appeals are local and time-sensitive. This page does not calculate the user's deadline or decide the merits.

sources.title: FOIA.gov
sources.purpose: Federal records-request, response, and appeal routing.
useFor: identifying a federal agency records office
checking request and appeal instructions
logging tracking numbers and response dates
limits: Federal agency rules, exemptions, fees, and deadlines vary. A FOIA request does not suspend another notice or order.

sources.title: File a Fair Housing Complaint
sources.publisher: U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development
sources.purpose: Federal route for housing-discrimination complaint information and contact options.
useFor: checking whether HUD's complaint channel is relevant
capturing the agency contact and submitted materials
preserving the notice and communication timeline
limits: HUD's process and any time limits can change. The page is not a legal determination and does not replace a notice, court filing, or advice from a qualified professional.
